p: plague: Which came because of their whoredom and idolatry.
near Jericho: Where the river is near to Jericho.
company of Korah: In that rebellion of which Korah was head.
became a sign: That is, as an example that others should not complain and rebel against God's ministers.
Canaan: Before Jacob went into Egypt, Ge 38:3,7,10,46:12.
numbered of the children of Israel: This is the third time that they are numbered.
whom Moses and Aaron the priest: In which appears the great power of God, that so wonderfully increased his people.
